info.title: MusMove direct online APIs
info.description: Source contract, not proof of deployment. Primary spec is openapi.yaml, which references these path items. Every mutation requires a UUID Idempotency-Key plus resource versions for updates/deletes. Scope/hash/receipt and domain writes commit atomically; same account/key/normalized body replays the original successful JSON/status, different content/path rejects409. Failed transactions save no receipt. No TTL cleanup/discovery endpoint, no skip endpoint, no new SETUP_REQUIRED recommendation guard. All ownership from Bearer JWT. JSON <=64KiB, depth32; mutation responses <=256KiB, reads <=3MiB. Account120/min and writes30/min;429 honors Retry-After; errors sanitized with requestId. Existing sync remains compatible. No new tables, cloud deployment, production personal writes or deletion of legacy device data.

get.description: Read identity, binary setup state, profile, training preferences, user preferences and all three versions without saving a draft.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

patch.description: One atomic PATCH for changed resources only. Include exactly their baseVersions. Omission preserves, nullable null clears, nested trainingContext merges; arrays replace. setupCompleted cannot be patched. Profile/training editor requires completed onboarding; budget/area preferences may be saved independently. Optional nutrition can remain unavailable. No query parameters.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

get.description: Legacy bounded offset cursor for owned history; from <= to. New collection cursors below are separately signed and cannot be used here.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

post.description: Submit once after finishing: full performed exerciseSnapshot, complete setLog, startedAt, finishedAt and local recordedOn >=1900-01-01. Always creates status completed; no start, resume, per-set or abort API. Source custom/recommended requires programId with matching ownership/catalog and mode; source manual must omit programId. Only source manual accepts optional newExercises (even an empty array); at most12 unique account-local new IDs, every one referenced by exerciseSnapshot and mode matching the workout. Existing local IDs including tombstones or any catalog ID conflict409; another account's matching ID is independently scoped, never a private reference. All exercise rows, workout, sync events and one whole-response receipt commit atomically or fully roll back. Fresh responses include exercises with canonical fields/version strings, empty if none; pre-upgrade receipts may replay item-only JSON. Valid historical references may be soft-deleted/inactive. Server canonicalizes exercise labels/requirements but never rebuilds sets/reps from a program or current recommendations. Custom exercise requirements are unverified and use [[]]. Results remain self-reported, not proof that a program was recommended. Key retry replays without duplication, including new exercise IDs already committed on a lost ACK; changed payload/key reuse rejects409. finishedAt >= startedAt; recordedOn within one day of UTC start day.

post.description: Strict final create with client-generated stable ID; IDs (including deleted IDs) cannot be reused. Program may atomically create newExercises; exercise references must be owned or active catalog and support its mode. Exercise labels/requirements are server-canonical, not client-authoritative. Exercise mode is immutable. Meals resolve catalog nutrition/estimated price server-side; journal summaries returned. Drafts remain private.

patch.description: Non-empty changed fields only; merge with persisted data before validation. Only declared nullable fields accept null. Preserve untouched metadata, nutrition/price snapshots and versions. Meal journals include both dates if moved. Program schedule slot conflicts return409; newExercises and program write are one transaction. History snapshots never change when program/exercise changes.
